description: A CLI and MCP server for your Forkable office-lunch program, with a local database and history, spend, and preference queries the web app cannot answer, plus commands to set, confirm, and skip meal orders (dry-run by default; --confirm to apply).

novel_features.name: Served-meal history
novel_features.description: See every meal actually served to you over time, with date, venue, price, and dietary level.

novel_features.name: Preference-vs-served drift
novel_features.description: Flag served meals that violate your stated dislikes or dietary restrictions, or miss your likes.

novel_features.name: Auto-selection explainer
novel_features.description: Explain why a delivery's meal was auto-selected by ranking candidate items and their scores.

novel_features.name: Spend trend over time
novel_features.description: Bucket lunch spend into per-week or per-month totals with CSV export.

novel_features.name: Allowance utilization
novel_features.description: Show granted-vs-consumed allowance utilization per club, including multi-club comparison.

novel_features.name: Week-ahead digest
novel_features.description: One agent-shaped line per upcoming day: date, venue, auto-selected item, price, allowance headroom.

novel_features.name: Venue rotation
novel_features.description: Rank venues by how often they've served you and how recently.
